## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). Direction: hand `ObjectGallery` the declared block nested, key by key

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-09T11:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: the fix is in `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, `generateViewSchema`'s gallery branch. That puts it in `domain:ui`.

- **Why p3:** a declared display key (`coverFit`, `cardSize`, `visibleFields`) is dropped on one route. The `ListView` route honours it. Nothing is lost or exposed.
- **Read on `main` `972e56659f`** (after objectui#12052 merged): the branch at `:2336`–`:2352` builds a flat `object-gallery` node. It carries `imageField` (from `coverField`) and `titleField` only. The round-14 comment explains why the raw spread was removed.

**Direction:**
- Build a nested `gallery` block on the node, listing each key by name. Take every key `ListViewSchema.gallery` declares and `ObjectGallery` reads from `schema.gallery`: `coverField`, `coverFit`, `cardSize`, `visibleFields` and `titleField`. That is the shape `ListView` already hands it.
- ⛔ No raw spread of the authored block. Round 14's reason stands: a spread carries every undeclared key, and a key named like a node key overrides the node's own value.
- Whether the flat `imageField` and `titleField` stay beside the block is the owner's call, measured against what `ObjectGallery` reads first. One spelling per key on the node is the target.
- Named `listViews` take the same branch, so pin them too.
- **Pins:**
  - `coverFit: 'contain'` through `ObjectView`'s `views` renders `object-contain`;
  - `cardSize` and `visibleFields` take effect the same way;
  - control: the `ListView` route is unchanged;
  - control: an undeclared key in the authored block does not reach the node.

Claim: PM loop round 3
Session: `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`
Account: `os-support-ai`
Branch: `claude/issue-12053-view-gallery-block`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12053`

Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface (on `main` `d03b0227`):
- `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, `generateViewSchema`'s gallery branch (about `:2353`). The `object-gallery` node gets a nested `gallery` block that lists each key by name: every key `ListViewSchema.gallery` declares and `ObjectGallery` reads from `schema.gallery`, namely `coverField`, `coverFit`, `cardSize`, `visibleFields` and `titleField`. That is the shape `ListView` already hands it.
- The flat `imageField` / `titleField` beside the block: keep or drop them as measured against what `ObjectGallery` reads first. The target is one spelling per key on the node; the dev names the choice and the reading.
- The tests beside it. Triage's pins (`6080379082`):
  - `coverFit: 'contain'` through `ObjectView`'s `views` renders `object-contain`;
  - `cardSize` and `visibleFields` take effect the same way;
  - named `listViews` take the same branch and are pinned too;
  - control: the `ListView` route is unchanged;
  - control: an undeclared key in the authored block does not reach the node.
- One `.changeset/12053-*.md` (`patch`).

⛔ Not on it:
- a raw spread of the authored block (objectui#6152 round 14's reason stands: it carries undeclared keys, and a key named like a node key overrides the node's own value);
- `ObjectGallery` itself, and every other view branch of `generateViewSchema`;
- `packages/i18n/**` and `packages/components/src/ui/**`.

If `ObjectGallery` reads a key from `schema.gallery` that `ListViewSchema.gallery` does not declare, or the reverse, stop and report it rather than widen either side.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this path: no path-derived mandate; default tier).
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui plugin-view: generateViewSchema builds a flat object-gallery node, so a gallery view's declared coverFit, cardSize and visibleFields never reach ObjectGallery through ObjectView's views prop | the platform path: the nested gallery block ListView already hands ObjectGallery | every host that passes gallery views to plugin-view's published ObjectView`
Thread-read: 6080379082
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **Open objectui PRs, read 2026-10-09T18:06Z:** none touches `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` or `ObjectGallery`.
- **Recent landings on this file:** PR objectui#12052 (objectui#6152 round 14) and PR objectui#12060 (round 15) have both merged; this branch starts from a `main` that carries them.
- **In-flight claims, read 2026-10-09T18:06Z:** this seat has none (serial dispatch).

Why `Clause-②: no`: a published view's declared display keys reach the renderer that already reads them; no export, prop, type or pack key changes.

ACCEPT — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-09T18:48Z. PR objectui#12069, head `c346c41f`.

- **PR shape:**
  - Draft against `main`, based on `d03b0227`. `git merge-tree` against `main` `d03b0227` is clean.
  - First line `Fixes #12053`, the body's only closing keyword. `Clause-②: no` at line start. Changeset `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-view`.
  - The commits carry only the model-free trailer pair. Assignee `os-support-ai`, set with no refusal.
- **Scope:** 5 files, +220/−20, on the claim `6086543001`. The governed-queue guard reads NOT GOVERNED.
  - The two existing plugin-view tests that pinned the flat `imageField` are re-spelled to the nested block. They are "the tests beside it". Accepted.
- **What lands:** `generateViewSchema`'s gallery branch gives the `object-gallery` node its own nested `gallery` block, the shape `ListView` already hands `ObjectGallery`.
  - The five keys are picked by name through `GALLERY_CONFIG_SPELLING`, which `satisfies` a record over the spec gallery block's keys, so `tsc` fails if the spec's set moves. The existing `pickFlatMapConfig` does the picking, with ⛔ no raw spread.
  - **One spelling per key:** the flat `imageField` / `titleField` are dropped, because `ObjectGallery` reads the nested `coverField` / `titleField` first (read order measured: `gallery.coverField ?? schema.imageField ?? 'image'`). The `'name'` title floor moves into the block.
  - **The declared set matches:** spec 17.7.0's gallery block and `ObjectGallery`'s reads are the same five keys, so no stop.
  - **Measured end to end through the real `ObjectGallery`,** on the host `views` route and on named `listViews`: `coverFit: 'contain'` renders `object-contain`, `cardSize: 'small'` the small grid, and `visibleFields` the card body. This was an uncommitted probe, because plugin-view does not depend on plugin-list. The committed pins hold at the node seam.
- **Gates:**
  - plugin-view: 74 files and 691 tests passed.
  - The control route (plugin-list's `ListView` and `ObjectGallery` set): 227 tests passed. The import side (app-shell, schema-catalog): 603 tests passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` exits 0.
  - Ablation: A1 (rebuild the flat node) gave 16 red as predicted, and A2 (a raw spread in the block) gave 3 red as predicted. Each restore was proven blob-equal.
  - CI on `c346c41f`: 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (the expected three), 0 failure.
- **Contract review:** not required (`Clause-②: no`).

**Findings, noted and not filed (observations, no wrong answer at a public door):**
- `ListView`'s gallery branch still spreads the authored blocks whole and writes a flat `titleField` beside `gallery.titleField`. The extra keys are inert there.
- Both routes floor `titleField` at the literal `'name'`, while `ObjectGallery`'s own ADR-0079 comment prefers `getRecordDisplayName`.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the queue, now. Its merge closes objectui#12053.
